item.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (React + Node.js), Sports Betting
item.description:
MANDATORY — hands-on experience with Odds88 or a comparable sports data / betting platform providers (Sportradar/Genius Sports/BetConstruct/Hub88/Softswiss ). This is the key selection criterion for this role.

The engineer must be able to build the full sports betting system: Odds88 integration, betting logic, and the bonus system around it.

 

Requirements

 

Position Name: Senior Full-Stack Developer (React + Node.js), Sports Betting
Level: Senior (only)

Hard skills requirements:

  • Hands-on experience with Odds88 or a comparable provider — Sportradar, Genius Sports, BetConstruct, Hub88, Softswiss (MANDATORY, key requirement)
  • At least 6 years of software engineering experience
  • At least 4–5 years production experience with Node.js (Nest.js / Express.js / Koa.js), building and operating backend services
  • At least 4 years with React — ability to deliver high-quality UI: responsive / mobile-first layouts, attention to detail, basic frontend performance hygiene
  • TypeScript in production: typing API contracts, safe refactors, avoiding any
  • Strong PostgreSQL + SQL: joins, aggregates, pagination patterns, indexing implications, transactions and isolation, row-level locks (SELECT … FOR UPDATE), handling double-submit/double-spend scenarios
  • Third-party API integration experience — external feeds, webhooks, retries, idempotency, reconciliation
  • Modern backend architecture: microservices, asynchronous communication, distributed systems basics (timeouts, retries, idempotency, backpressure)
  • Strong software design knowledge: OOD, FP fundamentals, design patterns, maintainable modular code
  • Proficient Git (PRs, reviews, branching, conflict resolution), Docker and CI/CD
  • Agile / SCRUM development practices

Would be great:

  • Direct Odds88 integration experience (strongest possible match)
  • Experience building bonus systems / promotions engines in iGaming
  • WebSockets at scale (live odds, real-time updates)
  • Messaging / eventing fundamentals (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS+SNS, NATS)
  • Tech/Team Lead experience
  • Observability: logs/metrics/tracing, SLO thinking

Soft skills requirements:

  • Strong communication — can discuss past integration work in technical detail
  • Proactivity and ownership
  • Able to reason about tradeoffs and defend technical decisions
  • Fast and independent learner

Responsibilities:

  • Build sports betting functionality for the client's platform
  • Integrate with Odds88 and related sports data feeds
  • Build the system supporting bonuses, betting and everything related to sports
  • Deliver full-cycle features: design → implementation → testing → rollout → monitoring
  • Own data correctness and performance in Postgres (transactions/locking, indexes, migrations, query optimization)
  • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, documentation and production support

English: Upper-Intermediate — must have
Office/Remote: Remote, full-time, long term

item.title: Senior Full-Stack Data Engineer (Node.js / React.js)
item.description:
Our Customer:

A global product company in the cybersecurity domain, focused on helping organizations identify and reduce risks across modern IT environments.

 

Your Tasks:

  • Develop and maintain production features across the full stack, from the React UI through the API to the database.
  • Design, maintain and troubleshoot Node.js and TypeScript backend services and production APIs.
  • Maintain and enhance the React front end, including modern React patterns, data flow and UI performance.
  • Own the data access layer in Node.js/TypeScript, keeping control over generated SQL and performance-critical behavior.
  • Design and evolve database schemas, relationships, constraints and data integrity rules.
  • Diagnose and optimize slow queries and production bottlenecks using execution plans and index analysis.
  • Plan and execute production database migrations with backward compatibility and minimal downtime.
  • Trace and resolve production incidents across the UI, API, data access layer and database.
  • Interface directly with the international client and engineering team in live technical discussions.
  • Deliver high-quality, resilient software updates with limited supervision.

 

Required Experience and Skills:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including recent hands-on full-stack work in production systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and Node.js frameworks such as NestJS or Hapi.js.
  • Expert-level knowledge of TypeScript in both backend services and data access layers.
  • Strong production experience with React, including modern React patterns and state and data flow.
  • Hands-on experience with state management libraries (MobX or Redux).
  • Strong practical SQL skills, preferably with PostgreSQL.
  • Hands-on experience with complex JOINs, aggregations and filtering on large datasets.
  • Proven ability to diagnose slow queries using EXPLAIN and ANALYZE, execution plans and index effectiveness validation.
  • Experience designing and maintaining data access layers with query builders or ORM tools.
  • Practical experience with schema design, normalization and denormalization decisions, constraints and data integrity.
  • Hands-on experience with multi-step transactional operations, rollback behavior, race conditions and transaction isolation trade-offs.
  • Experience with production database migrations, schema versioning, backward-compatible changes and zero-downtime deployment approaches.
  • Strong REST API experience, including over-fetching, N+1 problems, latency and efficient mapping of database data into API responses.
  • Demonstrated ability to trace production issues across the UI, API, data access layer and database.
  • Experience in production environments with large record volumes and high load.
  • Experience working in an Agile environment, maintaining code quality through peer reviews and testing.
  • Proven ability to work autonomously, clarify requirements and drive tasks to completion without continuous follow-up.
  • Proven ability to take ownership of outcomes across the full stack rather than a single component.
  • Proven ability to raise risks, blockers and missing information early and provide clear status updates.
  • Ability to enter an existing codebase and domain, absorb context quickly and adapt to established engineering practices.
  • Ability to receive direct feedback, discuss disagreements professionally and adjust quickly.
  • English – Upper-Intermediate

 

Would Be a Plus:

  • Hands-on experience with GraphQL schemas, resolvers and integration
  • Experience with Next.js and server-side rendering
  • Experience with stored procedures and database-side performance-critical logic
  • Experience with Redis and caching strategies that reduce unnecessary database load
  • Experience with AWS and cloud-based production environments
  • Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines
  • Background in cybersecurity or identity management
  • Experience with large-scale identity data (Active Directory or Entra ID)
  • Experience with data-intensive, analytics or enterprise high-load products

item.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
item.description:
Olive Systems is looking for strong Forward Deployed Engineers to work on complex technology projects for US-based clients.

 

This role is for experienced, hands-on engineers who can take an ambiguous customer problem, figure out what needs to be built, and turn it into a working production solution.

 

We care much more about your engineering ability, ownership, and problem-solving skills than about a specific technology stack.

 

What you’ll do

 

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of engineering, product, and the customer.

 

You’ll take ownership of problems that often don’t come with a complete technical specification and help determine what should be built, how it should work, and how to get it into production.

 

You’ll:

 

* Work directly with US-based customers to understand technical and business problems

* Turn ambiguous requirements into practical technical solutions

* Build prototypes quickly and take successful solutions into production

* Work across backend, frontend, APIs, infrastructure, data, and AI systems

* Make architecture and technical decisions with a high degree of autonomy

* Integrate solutions with existing customer systems

* Troubleshoot complex production and integration issues

* Work closely with engineers, product teams, and customer stakeholders

* Use modern AI coding tools and agents extensively as part of your development workflow

 

Who we’re looking for

 

We’re looking for strong engineers rather than specialists in one particular framework or stack.

 

You may currently be a:

 

* Senior / Staff Software Engineer

* Senior / Staff Full-Stack Engineer

* Technical Lead

* Hands-on Software Architect

* Founding Engineer

* Forward Deployed Engineer

* AI / Applied AI Engineer

 

You should be highly proficient in at least one of the following:

 

* Java

* JavaScript / TypeScript

* Python

* Go

 

But your primary programming language isn’t particularly important.

 

We’re looking for engineers who understand software deeply enough to move between technologies, learn unfamiliar systems quickly, and use AI coding tools and agents effectively to build production software.

 

What matters most

 

* Strong software engineering fundamentals

* Significant hands-on development experience

* Proven experience building and shipping production systems

* Ability to understand unfamiliar codebases and technologies quickly

* Strong system design and architecture skills

* Ability to solve problems without detailed specifications

* High level of ownership and independence

* Comfortable making technical decisions and explaining the trade-offs behind them

* Experience working directly with customers or business stakeholders

* Strong English communication skills

* Comfortable using AI coding tools and agents as a core part of your engineering workflow

* Ability to maintain meaningful overlap with US East Coast working hours

 

Experience building AI-powered products, LLM applications, agents, RAG systems, data platforms, or cloud-native systems is highly relevant, but not mandatory.

 

Location & Work Setup

 

Fully remote — Ukraine / Europe

 

The projects are primarily for customers on the US East Coast, so sufficient overlap with Eastern Time is required.

 

You’ll work in an international engineering environment on complex customer-facing projects where engineers are expected to understand the problem, make decisions, and own the solution from idea to production.

 

About Olive Systems

 

Olive Systems works with international technology companies to build and extend high-performing engineering teams.

 

We’re looking for engineers who don’t define themselves by a single programming language or framework. We want people who can understand difficult problems, learn quickly, use modern AI development tools effectively, and ship.

item.title: Platform Engineering Lead
item.description:
About the Product

We build a marketing data platform for the pharma industry. Our clients are pharmaceutical brands, and the campaigns reach verified healthcare professionals.

The platform enables marketing teams to run campaigns across channels such as Meta, LinkedIn, and programmatic advertising, and to measure campaign performance. The core product is a Laravel + Vue application running on GCP, backed by PostgreSQL and analytical data platforms including ClickHouse and BigQuery.

The team is small, fully remote across EU time zones, and releases continuously.

We are looking for a Lead Platform Engineer to lead the engineering team behind a large-scale web platform used by pharma marketing teams to run and measure their campaigns.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will lead a small team of developers and a QA engineer while continuing to write code yourself. You will shape how features are built, translate product requirements into clear technical specifications, make architectural decisions, and take ownership from development through release and production.

You will work closely with the Product Lead, who owns the product vision and priorities, and report directly to the CTO. Together, you will shape not only the technology behind the platform, but also its user experience and evolution.

What we're looking for

General

  • Product mindset: able to turn business goals into concrete user flows and product decisions, while challenging requirements that do not create real user value
  • 2+ years of technical leadership: experience as a Tech Lead, Team Lead, or hands-on Engineering Manager, including task breakdown, code reviews, mentoring, and 1:1s
  • 5+ years of full-stack engineering experience: building, shipping, and maintaining production web products
  • Production ownership: comfortable owning releases, incidents, reliability, and data correctness
  • Remote collaboration: comfortable working in a fully remote environment with overlap across EU time zones
  • English B2+: confident in written communication, as most day-to-day communication is asynchronous

Technical

  • UI/UX mindset: able to review existing user flows, identify friction, and implement meaningful improvements without depending on a designer for every change
  • Strong Laravel: hands-on experience with Eloquent, queues, events, service providers, testing, and production Laravel applications
  • Vue.js: experience with either Vue 2 or Vue 3. The existing SPA is based on Vue 2.7, Options API, Vuex, and Vue Router, so the ability to work effectively within an existing codebase is more important than framework preference
  • PostgreSQL: beyond CRUD — indexing, query optimization, execution plans, and migrations against live production tables
  • Strong SQL + analytical databases: practical experience with ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar technologies
  • Large-scale data: comfortable working with datasets containing hundreds of millions or billions of rows and understanding the performance implications
  • Technical documentation: able to write and maintain FRDs, architecture decisions, API contracts, and data models
  • GCP: experience designing and operating services using Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, GCS, or similar
  • Docker & CI/CD: hands-on experience with Docker and CI pipelines, preferably GitHub Actions
  • Automated testing: experience with unit, integration, and E2E testing and a mindset of improving test coverage over time
  • Production debugging & observability: comfortable working with Sentry, application logs, infrastructure logs, monitoring, and incident investigation

Soft Skills

  • Thinks in user flows, not just tickets — understands who the user is, what they are trying to achieve, and what should happen next
  • Leads by doing: breaks down work, reviews code, mentors engineers, removes blockers, and makes difficult technical calls when necessary
  • Strong written communication: can clearly document requirements, architecture decisions, and technical reasoning in English
  • Analytical mindset: investigates root causes rather than treating symptoms
  • Strong task and risk management: keeps work transparent, identifies dependencies, and raises risks early
  • Responsible approach to healthcare data: understands the importance of access control, consent, privacy, and PII

AI & Engineering Automation

AI-assisted development is an integral part of the engineering workflow. We are looking for someone who actively uses AI coding agents rather than treating them as occasional productivity tools.

We expect you to:

  • Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar tools on a daily basis
  • Be comfortable having AI draft a significant portion of production code while personally reviewing and validating the output
  • Run multiple AI agents in parallel using isolated branches or worktrees
  • Maintain project-specific AI context using tools such as CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, custom commands, and rules
  • Build AI-powered automations for recurring engineering tasks such as reporting, migrations, release checks, or test generation
  • Understand when AI-generated output is incorrect, incomplete, or unsafe — and know when to reject it
  • Take full ownership of anything that reaches production, regardless of whether it was written by you or an AI agent

Nice to Have

  • Experience with design systems or component libraries
  • Experience with Figma or similar tools for designing and communicating user flows
  • Experience defining product requirements directly with a Product Manager, founder, or business stakeholder
  • Background in AdTech, MarTech, or marketing analytics
  • Experience with healthcare or pharma products, particularly consent and PII handling
  • Infrastructure as Code experience with Pulumi or Terraform
  • Experience migrating Vue 2 to Vue 3
  • TypeScript experience
  • Apache Druid
  • BigQuery or ClickHouse performance and cost optimization

Responsibilities

  • Own the platform experience: make day-to-day UX and user-flow decisions and proactively identify improvements
  • Partner with Product: contribute to what gets built, challenge assumptions, propose alternatives, and advocate for the user
  • Lead a small engineering team: 2–4 developers plus QA, including task planning, code review, mentoring, and participation in hiring
  • Stay hands-on: design and implement features yourself while distributing work across the team
  • Own technical design: define data models, APIs, UI flows, testing strategy, and rollout plans
  • Write and maintain FRDs and keep technical documentation up to date
  • Work directly with the Product Lead on weekly priorities and delivery planning
  • Work with large-scale campaign data across PostgreSQL, BigQuery, ClickHouse, and Druid
  • Own releases and reliability: deployments, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and production support
  • Improve observability and engineering quality across the platform
  • Maintain and improve CI/CD and automated testing
  • Work responsibly with healthcare-professional data, including access, consent, and PII requirements
  • Report directly to the CTO and help define architecture and engineering standards

Tech Stack

Backend: PHP 8.3, Laravel 12, Redis
Frontend: Vue 2.7, Vuex, Vite
Databases: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Apache Druid
Cloud & Infrastructure: GCP, Docker, GitHub Actions
Monitoring: Sentry
Testing: PHPUnit, Cypress
AI: Claude Code and other AI coding agents

What We Offer

  • Real ownership of a major product area, including its technical direction and user experience
  • Fully remote work with flexible hours and overlap with EU time zones
  • Direct access to the CTO and the opportunity to influence architecture and engineering standards
  • Paid AI tooling, including Claude Code
  • The opportunity to work with large-scale data, including datasets with up to 1.5 billion rows
  • Complex real-world integrations with major advertising platforms
  • A small, experienced engineering team with minimal bureaucracy and fast decision-making
  • A role where you can influence what gets built, how it is built, and how the product evolves

 

Interview Process

  1. Intro Call — 30 min: expectations and mutual fit.
  2. Technical Interview — 90 min: architecture, data modelling, production failure modes, and AI-assisted development.
  3. Product Lead Interview — 45 min: collaboration, product thinking, and ways of working.

item.title: Staff Full-Stack Engineer (more Backend and Architecture tasks)
item.description:
B2B, remote, long-term cooperation. 

About the Role

The company is developing a consumer commerce platform that combines real-time 3D interactions with the purchase of physical products, including a real-money wallet and operational workflows. The technology stack is built entirely around TypeScript. The engineering team is small and experienced, working closely with the CTO. This role is for a highly experienced individual contributor to take technical ownership of backend architecture across a customer-facing web product, an internal operations platform, and supporting services. A key part of the role involves systems where correctness and reliability have direct financial impact, such as wallet and ledger functionality, transaction settlement, verifiable outcome generation, and fulfillment workflows. The platform uses an event-driven architecture within a TypeScript monorepo, including Fastify BFF services, asynchronous workers, shared domain components backed by PostgreSQL, MongoDB for analytics, Valkey for caching, RabbitMQ for messaging, and S3-compatible storage with CDN. Infrastructure runs on AWS ECS with infrastructure-as-code and automated CI/CD. You will work closely with the CTO on architectural direction and platform evolution.
 

Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of architectural decisions across backend services, including service boundaries, data ownership, idempotency, outbox patterns, caching, and failure handling.
  • Document important technical decisions and revisit them as requirements and system constraints evolve.
  • Design and evolve financially sensitive functionality, including double-entry wallet accounting, payments and withdrawals, inventory settlement, and auditable outcome-generation mechanisms.
  • Work across layers when necessary, from database schemas and Drizzle migrations through domain logic, Fastify APIs, asynchronous consumers, and React interfaces.
  • Provide technical leadership for the internal operations platform supporting catalog, fulfillment, finance, and customer-support workflows.
  • Establish engineering standards around contract-first APIs, deterministic testing, database migrations, and code-review quality.
  • Mentor other engineers while maintaining a hands-on individual-contributor role.
  • Own production reliability through observability, incident response, capacity planning, performance analysis, and ongoing reliability improvements.
     

Requirements

  • 8–9+ years of professional software engineering experience, including several years with direct responsibility for architecture and technical decisions in production systems.
  • Proven experience defining service boundaries, selecting appropriate storage technologies, and scaling production systems.
  • Practical understanding of capacity planning, caching strategies, database connection management, performance bottlenecks, and production debugging.
  • Ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs such as consistency vs. availability, synchronous vs. asynchronous communication, caching vs. source-of-truth access, and build vs. buy decisions.
  • Strong server-side engineering background with Node.js/TypeScript, .NET, or Java. Engineers coming from .NET or Java should be comfortable transitioning to TypeScript.
  • Deep experience with relational databases, including schema design, transactions and isolation levels, indexing, and migrations of live production systems.
  • Experience using document databases and caching systems where they provide clear advantages alongside relational storage.
  • Production experience with event-driven architectures, message brokers, idempotent processing, outbox patterns, and delivery guarantees.
  • Experience owning financially sensitive systems such as payments, billing, ledgers, trading, or similar transaction-heavy functionality.
  • Ability to document architectural decisions clearly and challenge technical assumptions when necessary.
     

About the Company

The company is a lean product team developing a consumer commerce platform that combines real-time 3D interactions with the purchase of physical products. The product also includes a real-money wallet and operational workflows for order processing and fulfillment. Their technology stack is built entirely around TypeScript. The engineering team is small and experienced, with engineers working closely with and reporting directly to the CTO, allowing for fast communication and decision-making.

item.title: Lead/Senior XP Full-Stack Engineer (Java / React)
item.description:
Our Customer:

A product-focused organization developing innovative, business-critical applications with a strong focus on modern engineering practices, scalable distributed systems, and AI-assisted development.
 

Your tasks:

  • Develop innovative, business-critical applications as a hands-on full-stack expert using Java, Spring, React, and related technologies.
  • Own and lead the complete engineering lifecycle, including technical discovery, solution design, architecture, implementation, testing strategy, DevOps, production readiness, and continuous improvement.
  • Lead architecture and design decisions for complex services, APIs, front-end capabilities, integration flows, and cloud-ready components.
  • Act as a technical authority for Java/Spring, React, microservices, cloud/hybrid, and container-based solutions.
  • Translate business needs into scalable, maintainable, secure, and testable technical solutions.
  • Guide other developers through remote pairing, code reviews, design reviews, mentoring, and hands-on technical leadership.
  • Drive XP practices, including pair programming, TDD/BDD, continuous integration, evolutionary design, and fast feedback loops.
  • Design and develop distributed systems with a focus on resilience, service discovery, scalability, observability, and performance.
  • Identify modernization opportunities, reduce technical debt, and improve system reliability, observability, performance, and deployment quality.
  • Promote engineering excellence through clean code, automation, testability, secure coding, reusable components, and clear technical documentation.
  • Work with CI/CD pipelines, automated quality gates, deployment automation, and production-readiness practices.
  • Design, develop, and deploy cloud/hybrid solutions in container-based environments such as Kubernetes or Cloud Foundry.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, unit-test generation, refactoring, documentation, troubleshooting, API exploration, and code-review preparation.
  • Apply responsible AI practices in software engineering, including validation of generated output, data sensitivity, security, intellectual property awareness, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Identify practical AI use cases that improve developer productivity, reduce manual effort, and increase delivery quality.
  • Evaluate technology options, make architectural trade-offs, and communicate technical recommendations to engineering and management stakeholders.

 

Required experience and skills:

  • 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including significant experience with enterprise-scale systems.
  • Expert-level experience with Java, including Spring, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, microservices, RESTful APIs, and integration-oriented architecture.
